raw.room_reading: The room is a rectangle with walls measuring 4100 mm each, and it has a floor area of 172 sqft. It has a door near Wall 4, a window in the middle of Wall 2, and solid walls on the other two sides. The height of the walls is 2500 mm. The客户希望
raw.design_plan: I propose a layout that maximizes space and storage while maintaining a clean and functional design. The hob will be placed on Wall 1, the sink on Wall 2, and the base cabinets will be a mix of shutt
raw.layout_why: This layout ensures that the hob and sink are placed in their respective walls, maintaining proper spacing for ergonomics. The base cabinets will be a mix of shutters and drawers,
raw.sink_why: The sink will be placed on Wall 2, which is opposite the hob on Wall 1. This placement provides enough space for easy access to both the sink and the hob.
raw.hob_why: The hob will be placed on Wall 1, which is one of the longest walls in the kitchen. This placement ensures that it is centrally located and easily accessible.
raw.lpg_why: The LPG cylinder unit is included by default, as per rule R11.
raw.tall_why: The customer wants tall storage, so I will include some tall units in the design.
raw.purifier_why: A water purifier was not stated, but I will include one to ensure the customer has a basic water purification solution.
raw.display_why: A glass display was not stated, but I will include one to provide additional storage and display options.
raw.open_why: An open shelf unit was not stated, but I will include one to provide a space for additional storage and display options.
raw.storage_why: The customer wants tall storage, so I will include some storage units in the design.
raw.features_why: The customer wants additional storage options, so I will include some feature units in the design.
raw.wall_cabinets_why: I will use double-shutter wall cabinets on Wall 2 to provide additional storage options.
raw.wall_style_why: I will use hinged shutters for the plain wall cabinets to provide a clean and modern look.
raw.finish_why: I will use matte PU finish for the base run and wall run to provide a modern and durable look.
raw.loft_why: The customer did not specify lofts, so I will not include any in this design.
